_comments.source: Hand-curated 2026-04-05. Clinical name: lateral epicondylitis / lateral elbow tendinopathy of extensor carpi radialis brevis origin.
_comments.hcpcs_rationale: 20551 is the classic lateral-epicondyle tendon-origin injection; 20550 (tendon sheath) also common. 24357-24359 are tenotomy codes (open, percutaneous, debridement) for refractory cases. 29837/29838 are elbow arthroscopy debridement. 76942 ultrasound guidance is very commonly billed alongside injections. 0232T captures PRP injection, a popular second-line treatment. 0101T extracorporeal shockwave therapy is another non-op option.
_comments.taxonomy_rationale: Orthopedic Surgery (including sports and hand subspecialties) does most tennis-elbow procedures; PM&R and Sports Medicine do the non-op injection/rehab workup.
_comments.pubmed_rationale: Mix of common and clinical names, plus treatment-modality queries (PRP, shockwave, corticosteroid, tenotomy).
